title: Representation ecology
_no_contract_was_frozen: No verdict contract was hashed and no organism was ever evaluated under a frozen criterion. Every number here comes from qualification probes, not from EXECUTE.
why_inconclusive_and_not_null: NULL would be a claim about the WORLD - that representations compute differently but produce no robust ecological distinction. That is not what happened. The ecological interaction was never genuinely exercised, because one substrate cannot persist against the other: TAPE invades TREE but TREE cannot invade TAPE, in every world iteration tested. The preregistration defines INCONCLUSIVE as exactly this case. Calling it NULL would claim a finding that was not earned.

preconditions.P1_non_degenerate: every reuse band produces a target that varies over its own input domain
preconditions.P2_two_sided: Delta(r) = F_TREE(r) - F_TAPE(r) changes sign across bands of ONE substrate-neutral generator
preconditions.P3_mutually_invasible: each substrate invades the other when rare, against an EVOLVED resident

gate_credibility.detail: The pre-fix world (targets generated as depth-3 expression trees) was run through the same gate and REFUSED on P2 and P3 in both executions: single band, delta +0.0036, no sign change; TREE invades TAPE but TAPE cannot invade TREE. The gate was therefore demonstrated capable of refusing before its verdict on the redesigned world was trusted.
gate_credibility._rule: the gate was never relaxed to admit; a refusal is recorded as a finding

what_was_achieved.substrate_leak_removed: CW01-D054 is closed on evidence. The redesigned substrate-neutral operation-graph generator produces Delta(r) that CHANGES SIGN across reuse bands (-0.0260, -0.0148, -0.0109, +0.0260), which the tree-native generator could never do (single band, +0.0036). Two-sided comparative advantage exists.
what_was_achieved.direction_reversal_confirms_the_leak: In the LEGACY world TREE invades TAPE and TAPE cannot. In the REDESIGNED world the direction REVERSES: TAPE invades TREE and TREE cannot. The invasion asymmetry follows the target geometry, which is independent confirmation that the substrate leak was real and is now gone.
what_was_achieved.degeneracy_and_dead_structure_fixed: CW01-D056's correction restored non-degeneracy in every band (4 -> 17 distinct outputs at band 0.75) and made tree_cost behave mechanically: 25/39/33/39 against tape_cost 12/14/12/14, no longer FALLING as reuse rises.
what_was_achieved.inherited_stack_proven: All five inherited engineering targets were demonstrated by observed refusal before any science: repopath across two directory depths, recordsafety ascii, tally-drift agreement, guardproof vacuous-fixture refusal, and writerlock refusing a git write while a live RowWriter existed.

what_was_not_achieved.mutual_invasibility: P3 never held, in four successive world iterations. TREE cannot invade TAPE from rarity in the redesigned world.
what_was_not_achieved.requirement_4: The design requirement that TREE-fixes, TAPE-fixes, coexistence, contingent dominance and no-difference must EACH be attainable is not satisfied: coexistence is not reachable in the exercised domain.
what_was_not_achieved.decisive_statistic_unmeasurable: The preregistered ecological quantity - frequency dependence of the interaction term, mixed minus solo-predicted - cannot be measured meaningfully in a world where one type cannot persist. Frequency-dependent coexistence has no referent when coexistence is unreachable.

limitations_and_residuals: The reuse axis is still only weakly realised: measured fan-out 0.00/0.07/0.17/0.07 against requested bands 0.00/0.25/0.50/0.75. Delta(r)'s sign change is real but is NOT demonstrably reuse-driven; it may be graph-to-graph variation. Recorded as a limitation rather than pursued, under the one-correction budget.

CW01-D055 stands: under this price list TAPE is universally at least as compact as TREE (it expresses any tree with n internal nodes in n instructions, where TREE pays ~2n+1 counting leaves). TREE's only plausible advantage is dynamic - subtree crossover transplanting an intact functional unit - and it never materialised into invasion ability.

Control A's rapid hitchhiking was deliberately deferred and remains unaddressed: labels fix at generation ~26 against a neutral-drift expectation of ~96, so the ecological noise floor is lineage hitchhiking rather than drift. It was never reached as a blocker because P3 failed first.
Two organism substrates only, small programs, a coarse four-band reuse grid, and a single attempt_id for qualification probes.
what_a_future_attempt_would_need: Not another parameter change. A price list or variation regime in which TREE has a genuine mechanical advantage that survives evolution - because the present one grants TAPE both compactness and local, incremental mutation, leaving TREE with no channel through which to invade. Mutual invasibility should remain a hard pre-QUALIFY gate: it cost minutes to evaluate and would have refused all four world iterations before any evolutionary budget was spent.
doctrine_promoted: Representation neutrality has at least three layers: neutral REWARD, neutral TASK GENERATION, and neutral ecological BOOKKEEPING. e06 satisfied layer one and accidentally violated layer two - the reward function never read the substrate label, but the target distribution was expressed in one substrate's native geometry. A representation-blind scorer is insufficient if the problem distribution itself is not.
